events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album turns 51
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic album 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1975.

angles.name: Imagine Legacy
angles.copy: More than five decades on, John Lennon's 'Imagine' album still resonates globally. What's your favourite track from this timeless masterpiece?

events.title: Sting turns 75
events.blurb: Gordon Matthew Thomas Sumner, known as Sting, the legendary musician and frontman of The Police, celebrates his 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Sting's 75th
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the incredible Sting! From The Police to his stellar solo career, which Sting track is on your playlist today?

events.title: The first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple introduced the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago today, Apple dropped this game-changer and changed how we listen to music forever. What was your first iPod, and what was on it?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond Favourite
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! We're celebrating 007's enduring legacy. Who's your favourite Bond, and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 86th birthday of The Beatles' co-founder, John Lennon, born in Liverpool in 1940.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your most cherished Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The iconic British actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, best known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Cleese's Comedy
angles.copy: Happy 87th Birthday to the legendary John Cleese! From 'Monty Python' to 'Fawlty Towers', his unique brand of comedy is truly timeless. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', on this day in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Anniversary
angles.copy: 58 years since The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album' on the world. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece. What are your standout tracks from this iconic record?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the passing of Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, one of music's most electrifying performers.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Today, we remember the one and only Freddie Mercury. His incredible voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' turns 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Influence
angles.copy: 61 years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly pushed boundaries. Its influence on pop music is undeniable. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the tragic passing of John Lennon, a global icon whose music continues to inspire peace and love.

angles.name: Lennon's Impact
angles.copy: On this poignant day, we remember John Lennon. His artistry and activism left an indelible mark on the world. What's the John Lennon song that means the most to you?

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary 'Chameleon of Rock', David Bowie, born in London in 1947.

angles.name: Bowie's 80th
angles.copy: Remembering David Bowie on what would have been his 80th birthday. A true innovator who constantly reinvented himself. What's your favourite Bowie era?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Today marks what would have been the 92nd birthday of 'The King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, born in Mississippi in 1935.

angles.name: The King's 92nd
angles.copy: Celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley on what would have been his 92nd birthday. The King lives on through his music! What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: The legendary guitarist and founder of Led Zeppelin, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Page's Riffs
angles.copy: Happy 83rd Birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page! The architect of some of rock's greatest riffs. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin guitar moment?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: The distinctive voice of Sir Rod Stewart, one of the best-selling music artists of all time, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rod's 82nd
angles.copy: Happy 82nd Birthday to the one and only Sir Rod Stewart! His raspy vocals have given us countless hits. What's your favourite Rod Stewart song?
